protocol.repairScope: Condition repositories are initialized and locally fetched from the verified source repository so both route and ground-truth commits remain available. No product or measurement rule changed.
protocol.orderRule: Even manifest indexes run baseline then candidate; odd indexes run candidate then baseline.
